Title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
Description:
Hidden Objects: Island Secrets is an exciting hidden object game where magic and time intertwine in a thrilling adventure. Everything changed when a mysterious magical crystal activated, scattering objects across time! You'll enter a world of riddles, hidden objects, and temporal paradoxes.

🔍With the help of a faithful guide whose hints will help you navigate the twists and turns of different eras, you'll embark on a journey through the unique locations of a single island, seen across different ages. Search for key items and artifacts scattered among the ancient ruins of the past.

🔍Each location is a vibrant puzzle where you'll need to use your attentiveness and wits to find all the hidden objects on your list.

🔍Enjoy the relaxing atmosphere, soothing music, and beautiful graphics. This game is designed for leisure, allowing you to leisurely immerse yourself in a world of adventure, play a classic hidden object game, and feel like a true explorer.
Instructions:
🔍 Find Hidden Objects — Explore locations and discover all the hidden items to uncover the island's secrets.

🔄 Free Movement — Move left and right across the location and use zoom to examine every detail.

📱 Play Anywhere — Enjoy the game on your computer or phone anytime.

💡 Hint Help — If an item is too hard to find, use a hint to continue your adventure.

Title: Fire Hose
Description:
Think you can handle the pressure?

Use your mouse or the left virtual joystick on mobile to move and aim, then click or hit the right trigger to spray and put out every fire before your water runs out.

Each level gets harder with more flames, trickier layouts, and less room for mistakes. Waste too much water and you will fail. Stay sharp, move fast, and clear them all.

Upgrade your water deposits to carry more water, spray longer, and survive tougher stages.

Move with the left joystick
Spray with the right trigger
Put out every fire
Upgrade your water deposits
Beat fast and challenging levels

Every drop counts. Start spraying now!
Instructions:
On desktop use the mouse to aim and click to release the water. Press Q to toggle mouse lock

On mobile user the virtual joystick and the button to trigger the water from the hose.
You win by extinguishing as many fires fires on the screen without running out of water

Title: Bird Game Clicker
Description:
This is a clicker game about hesitation, doubt, and the eternal “well… maybe”.

In this world, birds never give clear answers.
To any question you’ll hear:
“I doubt it”, “50/50”, “unlikely”, “partially”, “hard to say” — and dozens of other evasive replies.

Click, collect feathers, and upgrade your flock of doubtful birds.
Unlock new ones and complete the full collection of the most uncertain creatures in the world.

🔹 Feathers — used for regular upgrades and faster progression
🌾 Grain — a rare currency for unique improvements and special bonuses
📈 Many upgrades with unexpected effects
🏆 Leaderboards — compete to become the most doubtful keeper of grain
💬 Chat — talk with other players who are just as uncertain

You don’t need to be right here.
You just need to doubt.

Become a legend of hesitation.
Or… maybe not.
Instructions:
Tap the screen with the character and get game currency
Upgrade by game currency in the upgrade menu to earn even faster and collect a full collection of birds
Compete with other players and take the highest positions in the leaderboards
